name: screepsmod-admin-utils
description: Contract of the screepsmod-admin-utils mod on a community server (stock screeps/backend-local): its capabilities reply, room objects, shard and PvP/nuke summaries, start-room choice, spawn placement with an automatic mode, server statistics, battle classification, mod list and optional CORS. Its routes are registered before backend-local's own routes and server-password check.

provides.gameRoomObjects: Stock backend-local has no room-objects route; screepsmod-admin-utils serves the raw room object documents and their users.
provides.gameShardsInfo: screepsmod-admin-utils describes the single world as one shard.
provides.platformExperimentalPvp: screepsmod-admin-utils serves the PvP-activity summary for its one world.
provides.platformExperimentalNukes: screepsmod-admin-utils serves the in-flight nukes of its one world.

adaptations.gameRoomObjects: The reply is `{objects, users}` without `ok` (override: GameRoomObjectsResponse).
adaptations.gameShardsInfo: The single shard entry has no `users`; its `name` is `null` until a shard name is set, and `tick` is `null` before any tick was recorded (override: GameShardInfo).
adaptations.platformExperimentalPvp: `time` is sent once beside `pvp` instead of inside each shard entry, and `interval` defaults to 1000 and is clamped to 1-10000; `start` is an additional parameter (override: path, PlatformPvpShard).
adaptations.platformVersion: screepsmod-admin-utils replaces `GET /api/version`: it publishes the features mods register, which carry a package version string or no version, the `shardName` setting in `shards` (`null` until set) and any `additionalServerData`, and it is served without the server password (override: path, PlatformVersion).
adaptations.userWorldStartRoom: screepsmod-admin-utils replaces the route: it always returns exactly one plain room name, without shard, and falls back to a random sector-center room; no server password is checked (override: path, UserWorldStartRoomResponse).
adaptations.gamePlaceSpawn: screepsmod-admin-utils replaces the route: `name` is required and `auto` claims the room without placing a spawn; other players' structures are deleted without ruins and their construction sites stay; no server password is checked (override: path, GamePlaceSpawnRequest).

additions.platformMods: Lists the installed screepsmod mods; screepsmod-admin-utils' web UI and server tools read it.
additions.platformServerStats: Server statistics (players, rooms, creeps, tick timings) that dashboards and server lists poll from community servers.
additions.platformWarpathBattles: node-screeps-api exposes `GET /api/warpath/battles` for unofficial servers; screepsmod-admin-utils serves it.

behaviour.summary: All routes of the mod are registered on `expressPreConfig`, before backend-local's router and its `SERVER_PASSWORD` check, so they answer without `X-Server-Password`; failures of the routes wrapped by its `errCatch` answer HTTP 500 `{error: <stack trace>}`.

CORS is off unless `serverConfig.cors.origins` in config.yml lists origins. Then requests from those origins get CORS headers for methods `GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE`, allowed headers `Authorization, Content-Type, X-Token, X-Username, X-Server-Password` and exposed headers `X-Token, X-Username, X-Server-Password` (both overridable), and preflight requests are answered by the middleware; other origins get no CORS headers.
`GET /` redirects to `/web`, the mod's web UI (screepsmod-admin-utils-ui), instead of backend-local's landing page.

Registers the feature `{name: "screepsmod-admin-utils", version: <package version>}`; config.yml `features` entries replace (by `name`) or add features, and a config.yml `market` section adds the official `market` feature.
Adds socket channels `stats` (`stats:full`, `stats:users` after every tick) and `warpath` (`warpath:battle`, `warpath:battles`); socket plugin changes are not part of this contract.

notes.gameRoomObjects: Unauthenticated. Returns every document of `rooms.objects` in `room` as stored (with the default storage including its `meta` and `$loki` bookkeeping fields; flags are not room objects) and, in `users`, `{_id, username, badge}` of every referenced user plus the Invader (`2`) and Source Keeper (`3`) users. Any `room` value is accepted; an unknown room yields empty `objects`. `shard` is ignored.
notes.gameShardsInfo: One entry: `name` (the `shardName` setting), `cpuLimit` 0, `lastTicks` (up to the 30 most recent tick durations in milliseconds), `rooms` (all rooms of the world) and `tick` (their average).
notes.platformExperimentalPvp: Lists rooms whose `lastPvpTime` is at least `(start or the current tick) - interval`, keyed by the `shardName` setting (the key is `null` until one is set).
notes.platformExperimentalNukes: Every nuke object of the world, keyed by the `shardName` setting (`null` until one is set).
notes.platformVersion: `protocol` is 14, `useNativeAuth` is true when no `STEAM_KEY` is set, `users` counts active non-bot players with CPU. `serverData` holds `shards` (`[shardName]`), `welcomeText`, `customObjectTypes`, `historyChunkSize`, `socketUpdateThrottle`, `renderer`, `features` (every feature registered by mods: for example screepsmod-auth's `auth` (1), `auth-tokens` (no version) and `screepsmod-auth` (`2.10.1`), and `screepsmod-admin-utils` (`1.37.1`)) and any keys of `additionalServerData`. `packageVersion` is not sent. The shard name is only what `Game.shard.name` reports: socket channels, room history and requests still carry no shard, and the official client reads `shards` only to decide whether to show shard names.
notes.userWorldStartRoom: Returns a random room whose controller the caller owns, otherwise a random room whose coordinates both end in 5 (a sector center such as `W5N5` or `E15S25`), otherwise `W5N5`. `shard` is ignored.
notes.gamePlaceSpawn: `name` must be a string of at most 50 characters (`invalid params`). `name: "auto"` skips the coordinates and the construction-spot checks, claims the controller with `autoSpawn` and places no spawn; the first spawn construction site the player then creates in that room becomes a complete spawn when the tick is processed. Otherwise coordinates outside 0..49 are `invalid params` (missing coordinates are not rejected). It then checks the account (`blocked`, `no cpu`, `too soon after last respawn`), the room (`invalid room`, `out of borders`, `not supported`), `already playing`, the controller (`invalid room`, `room busy`) and the tile (`invalid location`). On success other players' creeps and structures in the room are deleted (no ruins; their construction sites remain), the controller is claimed at level 1 with 20000 ticks of safe mode, the room is activated and `{ok: 1, newbie: true}` is returned; CPU settings are not changed.
notes.platformMods: Unauthenticated; reads `mods.json` on every request and returns the `screepsmod-...` names found in its `mods` entries, in order, as a bare JSON array. Without a readable `mods.json` the request gets no reply.
notes.platformServerStats: Unauthenticated; computed on every request. `ticks.avg`, `min`, `max` and `maxDeviation` are `null` while no tick durations are recorded.
notes.platformWarpathBattles: Unauthenticated. Rooms with PvP since `(start or the current tick) - interval` (default 1000) are classified with the Voight-Kampff rules and returned as a bare JSON array; rooms without a fight are omitted. A failure leaves the request without a reply.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Ticks to look back from `start` (parsed with `parseInt`, clamped to 1-10000; 1000 when missing or invalid).

pvp.description: Keyed by the `shardName` setting (`null` until set).

get.description: Names of the installed `screepsmod-...` mods, read from the server's `mods.json`, as a bare JSON array without the `ok` envelope.

Server statistics computed from the database on every request: active players, room and creep counts, recent tick timings and one entry per active non-bot player. Bare JSON object without the `ok` envelope.

ticks.description: Recent tick durations in milliseconds, newest first.

stages.description: Average duration of each tick stage in milliseconds.

rcl.description: Number of owned controllers per level 1-8.

get.description: Recent battles of the world with their Warpath conflict classification, defender, attackers, power creeps and stronghold level, as a bare JSON array without the `ok` envelope.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Ticks to look back from `start` (1000 when missing, 0 or invalid).

classification.description: Warpath conflict class from 0 to 6; higher classes mean larger or better-defended fights.

defender.description: Username of the room owner or reserver; `false` when none.

attackers.description: Usernames of the other creep owners.

stronghold.description: Invader core level, 0 without a core.

GameRoomObjectsResponse.x-plugin-reason: screepsmod-admin-utils answers `{objects, users}` without the `ok` marker.
GameRoomObjectsResponse.description: Every room object of the room plus the public profiles of the referenced users, the Invader and the Source Keeper; no `ok` marker.

GameShardInfo.x-plugin-reason: screepsmod-admin-utils reports its one shard without `users`, with a `null` name until one is set and a `null` average before any tick.

rooms.description: Number of rooms of the world.

tick.description: Average of `lastTicks` in milliseconds; `null` while none is recorded.

PlatformPvpShard.x-plugin-reason: screepsmod-admin-utils sends `time` once beside `pvp` instead of in each shard entry.

PlatformVersion.x-plugin-reason: screepsmod-admin-utils publishes `config.backend.features` and its `shardName` setting: mod features carry their package version string or no version, and the shard list holds `null` until a name is set.

version.description: Feature version: a number for server features, the mod's package version string (for example `2.10.1`) for mod features, absent for some mod features (screepsmod-auth `auth-tokens`).

shards.description: `[shardName]`: the `shardName` setting, `null` until one is set. It is only what `Game.shard.name` reports; channels, history and requests carry no shard.

UserWorldStartRoomResponse.x-plugin-reason: screepsmod-admin-utils always returns exactly one room name without shard.

GamePlaceSpawnRequest.x-plugin-reason: screepsmod-admin-utils requires `name` and treats `auto` as automatic placement.

x.description: Required unless `name` is `auto` (then ignored); missing coordinates are not rejected.

y.description: Required unless `name` is `auto` (then ignored); missing coordinates are not rejected.

name.description: Spawn name (string, at most 50 characters). `auto` claims the room without placing a spawn; the first spawn construction site placed there becomes a complete spawn.
